evidence: A visitor recommends the small museum, praising its well-preserved artifacts and stunning frescoes.

evidence_sources.author: zetazzed
evidence_sources.excerpt: The museum of prehistoric Thera is also worth a visit if you make it there! It is fairly small but contains some incredibly well-preserved artifacts. The frescoes are stunning.

source_story_title: Greece has its own Pompeii: Thera buried Akrotiri in ash 17th-16th century BCE
